quiz.q: Solve x+12x​=x+1−2​+1.解方程 x+12x​=x+1−2​+1。
opts: x=−1
no solution无解
x=3
x=−21​
quiz.hint: NPV x=−1 first; multiply every term by x+1.先写 x=−1；每一项都乘 x+1。
quiz.why: Correct: 2x=−2+(x+1) gives x=−1, which is the NPV — no solution.正确：2x=−2+(x+1) 得 x=−1，正是不允许值——无解。
whys: Did not compare with the NPV: x=−1 makes the denominator 0, so it is extraneous.没和不允许值比较：x=−1 使分母为 0，是增根。
Correct: 2x=−2+(x+1) gives x=−1, which is the NPV — no solution.正确：2x=−2+(x+1) 得 x=−1，正是不允许值——无解。
Dropped the sign of −2 when clearing fractions.去分母时把 −2 的负号丢了。
Did not multiply the whole-number term 1 by the LCD.整数项 1 没有乘公分母。

quiz.q: One volunteer paints a fence alone in 3 h. With a second volunteer, it takes 2 h. How long would the second volunteer take alone?一名志愿者单独刷完一段围栏要 3 小时，和第二名志愿者一起刷要 2 小时。第二名志愿者单独刷要多久？
opts: 1 h
61​ h
1.2 h
6 h
quiz.hint: Rates add: 31​+t1​=21​.效率相加：31​+t1​=21​。
quiz.why: Correct: 31​+t1​=21​ ⇒ t1​=61​ ⇒ t=6 h.正确：31​+t1​=21​ ⇒ t1​=61​ ⇒ t=6 小时。
whys: Subtracted times (3−2); times do not combine — rates do.把时间相减（3−2）；时间不能直接加减，要用效率。
Found the rate 61​ fence per hour and reported it as the time; flip it.求出效率 61​（每小时刷 61​）就当成时间了；要取倒数。
Added the rates 31​+21​ instead of subtracting 21​−31​.把效率相加成 31​+21​，应是 21​−31​。
Correct: 31​+t1​=21​ ⇒ t1​=61​ ⇒ t=6 h.正确：31​+t1​=21​ ⇒ t1​=61​ ⇒ t=6 小时。

quiz.q: Solve x3​=x+45​.解方程 x3​=x+45​。
quiz.hint: Cross-multiply: 3(x+4)=5x.交叉相乘：3(x+4)=5x。
quiz.ans: x=6
quiz.why: NPVs x=0,−4. 3x+12=5x, so x=6.不允许值 x=0,−4。3x+12=5x，x=6。

quiz.q: Solve x−x6​=1.解方程 x−x6​=1。
quiz.hint: Multiply by x.两边乘 x。
quiz.ans: x=3 or x=−2x=3 或 x=−2
quiz.why: x2−6=x → x2−x−6=0 → (x−3)(x+2)=0. Neither is the NPV 0.x2−6=x → x2−x−6=0 → (x−3)(x+2)=0。都不是不允许值 0。

quiz.q: A junior hockey team rents ice for $378 and splits the cost equally among its players. When 3 more players join, each player pays $3 less. (a) Write an equation for the original number of players x and solve it. (b) Explain which solutions are rejected and why. (c) Verify with the actual share per player before and after.一支青少年冰球队租冰场花 $378，由队员平均分摊。又有 3 名队员加入后，每人少付 $3。(a) 为原来的队员人数 x 列方程并求解。(b) 说明哪个解要舍去，为什么。(c) 用加入前后每人实际分摊的钱验证。
quiz.hint: Multiply by the LCD x(x+3). The equation reduces to x2+3x−378=0.乘公分母 x(x+3)，方程化为 x2+3x−378=0。
quiz.ans: (a) x378​−x+3378​=3 gives x=18; (b) x=−21 is rejected (people cannot be negative); (c) $21 before, $18 after.(a) x378​−x+3378​=3 得 x=18；(b) x=−21 舍去（人数不能为负）；(c) 加入前每人 $21，加入后 $18。
quiz.why: Original share x378​, new share x+3378​, so x378​−x+3378​=3 with x=0,−3.原来每人 x378​，现在每人 x+3378​，所以 x378​−x+3378​=3，x=0,−3。
